title: Restore repeatable ECR chaining and the post-resume T03 recovery transition

triggerEvidence.summary: The approved post-resume recovery transition requires two different commits to be the same base SHA.
reproduction: Resume W1 from clean commit bf27fddd8e1732feadc698cd77f540ea9e1c7a0e; the controller records that commit as campaign.base_sha and writes the resumed backlog state.
Commit the validated resume state at 54d03055b1c6d9b702859d5fefbbac1e38de39df so recovery can satisfy the clean-worktree requirement.
Recover with base 54d03055b1c6d9b702859d5fefbbac1e38de39df; observe Exact T03 recovery base must match the resumed W1 compare-and-swap boundary.
Recover with base bf27fddd8e1732feadc698cd77f540ea9e1c7a0e; observe Base SHA must equal the current Git HEAD.
triggerEvidence.requiredRecovery: Separate immutable resume-record identity from the current committed HEAD used for stale-writer compare-and-swap, and test the real resume-write/commit/recover sequence.

triggerEvidence.summary: The passing recovery tests omit the governed resume persistence and commit sequence.
reproduction: Inspect tests/foundation/test_task_recovery.py: successful fixtures directly assign wave.campaign.base_sha to the same synthetic HEAD returned by the patched git_execution_identity.
The real-persistence fixture exercises save_atomic and competing-writer denial but does not run wave resume, commit its state, and invoke recovery through the CLI.
triggerEvidence.requiredRecovery: Add an isolated real-Git integration that invokes the actual resume and recovery controllers across their required commit boundary.

triggerEvidence.summary: The current generic ECR lane cannot represent the next repair amendment after the released GRR-0001 hold.
reproduction: Inspect tools/planctl.py _authority_chain_v2_errors: an ECR packet must match a backlog recovery hold whose post_bootstrap fields already name the proposed ECR, amendment, and authorized tasks.
Inspect taskctl command_amendment_append_bootstrap_submit: a matching ACTIVE recovery hold with approved bootstrap is mandatory.
The only existing hold is RELEASED and binds ECR-0002/W1.A03/W1.A03.T01, so ECR-0003/W1.A04 cannot validate or append.
triggerEvidence.requiredRecovery: Install a new sequential hold and versioned reusable ECR authority path without reopening or rewriting GRR-0001.

commandsDenied: ordinary Wave task claim, recover, reopen, evidence attachment, submission, or review transition
unapproved amendment bootstrap, materialization, activation, disposition, exit, or adoption
release-gate approval or local-main integration represented as approval
direct recovery-controller, ECR-controller, product, reference, or backlog change outside the approved bootstrap/amendment lanes
releaseConditions: GRR-0002 is independently reviewed and explicitly approved at one immutable commit.
GRR-0002.B00 installs and validates the new hold and reusable ECR chain within its exact scope and receives independent approval.
ECR-0003/W1.A04 is separately packet-reviewed, explicitly approved, completed, independently exit-reviewed, and adopted.
W1.A04 adoption records a bound control/security checkpoint before HOLD-W1-GRR-0002 is released.
After release, W1 is explicitly resumed before the corrected exact T03 recovery is invoked.

bootstrapUnit.exceptionReason: The only active-hold-bound ECR schema/controller identity has been consumed and released, so the ordinary lane cannot authorize the next amendment needed to repair the unsatisfiable post-resume recovery transition.
requiredOutcomes: A new immutable GRR-0002 authority and HOLD-W1-GRR-0002 can be installed under the exact paused W1 boundary while the released GRR-0001 record remains byte/history intact.
Only one hold may be ACTIVE for W1, released predecessor holds remain terminal, and older controller revisions fail closed when the new hold/control revision is present.
A new versioned ECR format freezes the complete W1 base plus W1.A01/A02/A03 chain and can represent exactly ECR-0003/W1.A04/W1.A04.T01 under the matching new hold.
Historical ECR-0001, ECR-0002, GRR-0001, W1.A01, W1.A02, and W1.A03 packets, approvals, findings, reviews, checkpoints, and effective states remain valid and unchanged.
GRR, ECR, amendment, hold, bootstrap, task, Wave, and predecessor identities remain exact, consecutive, hash-bound, canonical-path-safe, and independently reviewed.
Dirty, stale, duplicate, reordered, cross-Wave, wrong-hold, released-hold reuse, multiple-active-hold, wrong-hash, unsafe-path, self-review, and direct ordinary-execution states fail atomically.
The stopped-recovery handoff exposes GRR-0002 packet, authority, alternatives, review disposition, exact approval wording, and the separately required ECR-0003 approval.
B00 receives an independent control/security disposition before ECR-0003 is prepared or appended.
prohibitedOutcomes: No change to command_recover, CAP-02.S04.T03 product/runtime, approved UI reference, UI evidence contract, privacy policy, task acceptance criteria, verification thresholds, completed task outcomes, W1 approval, or release gates.
No reopening, reactivation, replacement, deletion, or rewrite of GRR-0001, its hold, B00/B01 attempts, approvals, findings, reviews, release record, or Git objects.
No ECR-0003 approval, W1.A04 materialization/activation/task claim, T03 recovery, W1 resume, G1 approval, local-main integration, or remote push before the later governed transitions authorize them.
No force, override, bypass, skip-review, arbitrary hold installation, arbitrary historical-candidate recovery, or manual task completion path.

acceptanceCriteria: The exact W1 base and ordered adopted W1.A01/A02/A03 authority, hashes, commits, checkpoints, task outcomes, and adoption histories remain unchanged.
The exact paused W1/T03/G1 boundary and both byte-stable recovery denials are reproducible and bound to the packet.
A second GRR and active hold are represented without reopening or rewriting the terminally released GRR-0001 hold.
A versioned next-ECR lane accepts exact ECR-0003/W1.A04/W1.A04.T01 identity and rejects gaps, duplicates, predecessor drift, wrong/released holds, cross-Wave identity, or hidden extra tasks.
The bootstrap controller changes only governance/schema/test/documentation paths and cannot implement or invoke the later T03 recovery correction.
All unsafe path, wrong hash, dirty, stale, self-review, adverse-review, concurrent-writer, and invalid lifecycle attempts fail without ledger mutation.
Generated status/review surfaces truthfully distinguish GRR-0002 B00 authority from the separately required ECR-0003/W1.A04 approval and ordinary W1 resume.
B00 review and remediation are append-only and commit-bound, and no product, T03, Wave-exit, gate, merge, or remote action occurs.
verificationObligations: Validate this packet against the exact generic Draft 2020-12 v2 GRR schema and verify every listed file SHA-256.
Verify every W1 base/A01/A02/A03 packet, approval, effective-state, checkpoint, hold-release, resume, denial, and pause commit exists on current history and matches the declared immutable blobs.

Run focused recoveryctl, planctl, taskctl, backlog-schema, generated-view, review-page, and quality tests including a released first hold followed by a second active hold and next-ECR append projection.
Probe cross-Wave, duplicate, gapped, reordered, wrong/released-hold, unsafe-path, hash-tamper, self-review, stale-writer, and older-controller boundaries and prove atomic denial.
Independently review GRR-0002 at its exact clean packet commit before human approval and independently review B00 before any ECR-0003 packet is prepared.

Defer the command_recover correction, real resume/commit/recover regression, T03 privacy/product qualification, full W1 matrix, local-main integration, and G1 review to their separately authorized gates.
rollback: Before exact human approval, reject or defer GRR-0002 while retaining its immutable proposal; W1 and T03 remain paused/blocked.
During B00, any failed validation or review retains HOLD-W1-GRR-0002 and requires append-only strict-descendant remediation with a fresh independent disposition.
After approved B00 but before ECR-0003 approval, withdraw or defer the ordinary ECR without releasing the hold or resuming W1.
After W1.A04 adoption but before exact T03 recovery, withhold hold release or Wave resume if any authority/checkpoint validation fails.
Never roll back by deleting, replacing, reopening, or rewriting a GRR, hold, approval, amendment, checkpoint, finding, review, evidence record, task block/recovery history, or Git object.
nonGoals: No product/UI/privacy/reference change, T03 recovery or approval, W1 qualification, G1 approval, local-main merge, or remote push.
No general emergency override, arbitrary hold creation, arbitrary amendment append, arbitrary historical-candidate recovery, or force option.
No weakening of independent review, explicit human approval, exact-commit evidence, privacy/security review, canonical full profiles, or complete Wave-exit qualification.
No cloud, external service, credential, hardware, deployment, benchmark, researcher-data, or substantial-spend action.
